name: ProEvolve
description: ProEvolve is a graph-based framework that programs environment evolution to generate scalable and controllable agent environments, enabling evaluation of agent adaptability to dynamic real-world conditions.
reputation: A research prototype for evaluating agents in evolving environments, with limited evidence of broad benchmark adoption outside the originating work.
notes: Enables automatic generation of 200 evolved environments and 3,000 task sandboxes for benchmarking agents' robustness and adaptability.
